outOfScope: Re-migrating DONE work or reconstructing its historical Blackboard lifecycle.
Long-lived dual-write or compatibility reads after cutover.
Redesigning Blackboard V2 semantics delivered by BB-155.
Bulk archival/pruning of historical raw evidence not required for current unfinished work.
constraints: BB-155 must be DELIVERED before migration execution begins.
Migrate only tasks that are unfinished and not explicitly withdrawn at the exact cutover snapshot. DONE tasks are not migrated; their delivered truth is Living Docs.
No dual-write and no long-lived legacy reader after cutover. V2 becomes the sole write/read authority for migrated current work.

Preserve work ids, semantic objective/current plan, direct dependencies, components, lane/phase meaning, and any current readiness/candidate/evaluation authority that is still valid at the cutover snapshot.
Do not invent historical generations. Each migrated Work starts at V2 generation 1 (or one deterministic initial generation) with legacy source SHA recorded as migration provenance.
Existing raw evidence/receipt files may remain as immutable referenced blobs when still required by an unfinished Work; physical storage cleanup is not required for cutover.
Migration must fail before authority switch if any unfinished Work cannot be transformed or if parity/next-action verification differs.
invariants: Cutover operates on one exact legacy snapshot SHA and one exact V2 implementation version delivered by BB-155.
Every live legacy work id appears exactly once in the migration manifest; DONE/withdrawn ids appear zero times.
A migrated Work's semantic objective/plan and direct dependency meaning are preserved, not reinterpreted during migration.
Current trusted readiness/candidate/evaluation facts are carried only when their existing exact bindings validate at the snapshot; stale authority is not promoted.
Authority flips only after complete migration and parity verification; there is no state where some current work is writable in legacy and some in V2.
architectureDecisions: D1 — BB-156 consumes BB-155 as a hard dependency. At Worker start, pin `legacySnapshotSha` to the exact candidate baseline and enumerate all legacy tasks where status != DONE, excluding explicitly withdrawn BLOCKED duplicates by an exact predicate recorded in the migration manifest.

D2 — Produce BLACKBOARD_V2_MIGRATION_MANIFEST_V1 containing source SHA, V2 schema/controller version, included ids, excluded DONE ids/count, excluded withdrawn ids/reasons, per-work source refs/hashes, and a manifest hash. Migration is deterministic from this manifest.

D3 — Transform each included task into one WORK_RESOURCE_V2. Preserve id, objective semantics, current plan semantics, direct dependencies and components. Map legacy RESEARCH_SA/RESEARCH to the corresponding V2 research state and WORKER/EXECUTION to the corresponding ready/execution state based on validated plan/readiness bindings; later phases map only when exact legacy authority exists.

D4 — Set migrated Work generation deterministically to the V2 initial generation; record `{legacySnapshotSha, legacyTaskId, legacyObjectiveHash, legacyPlanHash}` as migration provenance. Do not reconstruct old generations from Git history.

D5 — Revalidate any carried readiness/evaluation/candidate/evidence bindings with the trusted existing validators before materializing them as V2 conditions/attempt receipts. Invalid/stale authority causes migration failure for that Work instead of silent downgrade or promotion.

D6 — Before cutover, run all-work parity: legacy task readiness/blockers vs V2 lifecycle blockers, exact dependencies, objective/plan hashes, and `bb-v2 next` expected immediate action class. Any mismatch fails the migration.

D7 — Publish all V2 Works and the cutover marker atomically/CAS on the V2 control authority. Only after that publication succeeds, change repository operator/bootstrap surfaces to V2 and retire legacy current-work routing. No dual-write adapter is introduced.

D8 — DONE legacy tasks are not represented in V2. Their current delivered semantics continue from Living Docs. Withdrawn duplicate tasks are absent. Existing evidence/receipt blobs required by migrated unfinished work may remain at their old refs and are treated as immutable external blobs until a separate storage cleanup.
implementationSlices: S1 — Snapshot + manifest: enumerate the exact unfinished/non-withdrawn legacy set and bind every source object/hash.
S2 — Transform + authority validation: materialize one V2 Work per manifest item and validate any carried readiness/candidate/evidence authority.
S3 — Full parity gate: compare dependencies, blockers, semantic hashes and immediate next-action class for every migrated Work.
S4 — Atomic cutover: publish the complete V2 set plus cutover marker, then switch bootstrap/operator docs/scripts to V2 with no dual-write.
S5 — Legacy retirement: remove current-work legacy routing/projections for migrated tasks and prove DONE/withdrawn work is absent from V2.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: One exact migration manifest contains every unfinished non-withdrawn legacy Work exactly once and contains no DONE/withdrawn Work.
evidenceRequired: Manifest count/id-set checks against the pinned legacy snapshot.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Each migrated V2 Work preserves id, objective/current-plan semantics, direct dependencies/components and only validated phase-relevant authority.
evidenceRequired: Per-work hash/edge parity and stale-authority rejection fixtures.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Before cutover every migrated Work has equivalent dependency blockers and equivalent immediate lifecycle action class in legacy and V2.
evidenceRequired: All-work parity report with zero mismatches.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Authority cutover is all-or-nothing and leaves V2 as the only current-work read/write authority with no dual-write path.
evidenceRequired: Crash/failure fixture before commit leaves legacy authoritative; successful fixture makes all manifest ids resolvable from V2 only.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: DONE and withdrawn legacy tasks are not migrated to V2; DONE truth remains Living Docs and withdrawn duplicates remain absent.
evidenceRequired: Explicit excluded sets/counts and absence assertions.

negativeVerificationCases: A DONE or withdrawn legacy task appears in the V2 migration manifest.
A stale legacy readiness/candidate/evaluation binding is silently carried into V2.
Cutover partially publishes migrated Work or leaves both legacy and V2 writable for current unfinished work.

negativeCaseBindings.testTitle: BB-156 N1 migration excludes DONE and withdrawn legacy work
BB-156 N2 stale legacy authority cannot migrate into V2
BB-156 N3 cutover is atomic and never dual-writes

researchGaps: At Worker execution, pin the exact legacy cutover snapshot and generated unfinished/non-withdrawn manifest; the current registration-time task count is informational only because concurrent work may complete before BB-155 is delivered.

livingDocs.statement: Living system state records that V2 is the sole current-work Outer Blackboard authority after the one-shot unfinished-work cutover; DONE work remains represented by Living Docs rather than migrated work resources.
